name: Google Single Sign-On
tagline: Enables Google external login setup (Single Sign-On) for Virto Commerce Platform and Frontend

git.lastCommit: c2fcf31 2026-07-15 ci: Auto update Github Action workflows

readme.overview: Google Single Sign-On (SSO) is a module that provides users with a simplified sign-in experience. It allows users to access multiple applications with a single set of credentials, eliminating the need to remember different usernames and passwords for each application.
keyFeatures: The Google SSO module can be integrated with both the Virto Commerce Platform and the Frontend Application

notes.forAnalyst: Signing in with a Google account.
notes.forArchitect: The same authentication-adapter shape as the Entra ID module: no dependencies, no storage, configuration only.
notes.forDeveloper: Restrict to your workspace domain unless you genuinely want any Google account to reach the login screen.
reachForItWhen: Users must sign in with an identity your organisation already owns
You need to stop managing passwords in the platform
A B2B customer requires their own directory
doNotReachForItWhen: Authorisation questions — this only proves who someone is
Storefront customer accounts, unless the business really wants a corporate directory for shoppers
You expect roles to arrive automatically: mapping is configuration you must do
